title: Suggested: Validate file extensions in read_image tool
description: DSL-17 attempt 1 failed because the agent called read_image on Procedural.obj (329MB OBJ file). The read_image tool accepted it, base64-encoded the massive text file as an image, and caused an API streaming error — killing the session after only 51 messages. The read_file size guard was bypassed because the agent used read_image instead. Fix: read_image should validate file extensions and reject non-image files (.obj, .stl, .dsl, .json, etc). Only accept known image extensions (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .bmp, .webp, .tiff).
definition-of-done: read_image rejects non-image file extensions with a helpful error message directing the agent to use obj_summary or read_file instead
testing-plan: Call read_image on a .obj file and verify it returns an error instead of trying to encode it
